channel.title: Sam 🌋 Wild Adventures — Guides & Field Notes
channel.description: Practical Japan outdoor guides, cold-weather mountaineering gear roundups, mountain route guides, and expedition field notes.

item.title: Japanese Alps Mountain Huts (Yamagoya): Booking, Cash Rules & Ridge Guide
item.description: Practical guide to booking and staying in Japanese Alps mountain huts (yamagoya) around Kamikochi, Karasawa Cirque, Hotakadake and Yarigatake: yen prices, 1-month booking windows, 15:00 arrival rules, bento breakfasts and cash etiquette.

item.title: 4-Season Mountaineering Tents: Tunnel vs. Geodesic Domes & Storm Pitching (2026–2027 Guide)

item.title: Cycling Japan End to End (Cape Soya to Cape Sata): Route, Rinkō & Logistics (2026–2027 Guide)
item.description: Practical guide to cycling Japan end to end (Cape Sata to Cape Soya): 2,700–3,500 km route options, May–June tsuyu rain strategy, JR Shinkansen rinkō bag rules, Kanmon Tunnel, Tsugaru ferries, Toyoko Inn bike storage and 2026 blue-ticket laws.

item.title: Hiking Corsica's GR20: 7 Lessons, Huts, Costs & Gear (2026–2027 Guide)

item.title: Mountaineering Boots Explained (B1, B2, B3 & Double Boots): Matching Crampons to Peaks (2026–2027 Guide)

item.title: Tokyo: 6 Best Running Routes Without Traffic Lights & Runner Stations (2026–2027 Guide)

item.title: Climbing Mount Kinabalu (4,095m): Permits, Via Ferrata & Gear (2026–2027 Guide)

item.title: Daisetsuzan Grand Traverse (Hokkaidō): Route, Huts, Water & Bear Rules (Tested Guide)

item.title: 6 Best Offline Mountain GPS & Topo Apps Compared (2026–2027 Guide)

item.title: Kilimanjaro vs. Aconcagua: Difficulty, Altitude & Cost (2026–2027 Guide)
